text:
maya: Quick planning huddle — can we lock the Q2 Hosted API initiative gating this week? I put together a compact checklist and a proposed customer ambassador canary.
alex: Sure. paste the checklist? need perf + quality + ops gates not to be vague.
samir: Also need capacity numbers. we can't surprise infra late.
maya: copy: 
- Perf: p95 gen latency <= 200ms for 2k token median workload
- Cost: unit token cost delta <= +15% vs current baseline
- Quality: regression rate <= 1% on our core eval set (chat + completions)
- Embeddings: 99% similarity stability on top-10 pairs (no drift > 4%)
- Rerank: NDCG drop <= 0.02 on customer testsets
- Safety & compliance: no new high-risk failures in 10k prompt sweep
- Ops: automated rollback on errors >= 0.5% requests for 5m
- Canaries: 5 ambassador customers, 2 internal apps, 48h heat window
jen: This is helpful. add an explicit QA gate: pass 3 prompt suites (search, chat, code) with human spot-checks and sample size >= 300 prompts.
luis: From customer side — ambassadors want a clear SLA for fallback. they'd rather degrade to current model than get noisy outputs. can we commit to deterministic fallback route?
alex: Architect note: fallback ok but needs compatibility layer for tokenization/response format. extra ~2w work unless we reuse the compatibility shim from last release.
samir: Capacity note: ambassador cohort + 2 internal apps looks like ~15% throughput bump on our Dedicated pools for 2 weeks. we can absorb with burst capacity but need a short reserved credit or pre-reserve GPUs. estimate cost ~$9k/week if burst > baseline.
maya: Tradeoff: we can shrink canary size to 3 customers and 1 internal app to cut infra to ~8% bump. proposal: 3 external ambassadors + 1 internal, 72h window, extend if no regressions.
alex: Tech risk: quantized variant of the model has ~10% cost win but increases regen-time by ~30ms p95. That still fits perf gate? say p95 target to 200ms includes margin.
jen: Rollout plan: feature-flagged route, AB test 10/90 traffic split, automatic rollback on error or quality alert. Ops runbook created, have runbook owner (jen) and oncall (samir) tagged.
maya: Decision needed: pick canary size (3 vs 5), reserve credit (yes/no), accept quantized perf impact (yes/no). I prefer 3, yes reserve, accept quantized if we meet p95.
luis: Customers ok with 3 ambassadors as long as we have deterministic fallback and cadence of check-ins.
samir: I'm +reserve. will provision with 24h notice. need the final canary start window by EOD Tuesday.
alex: I'll scope the compatibility shim as a toggleable library; 2w dev, but we can ship a minimal shim in 1w with degraded features. recommend minimal shim for canary.
maya: Good. Action items: 
- alex: produce minimal compatibility shim PR by Monday
- samir: hold reserve credit option and cost estimate by EOD Tuesday
- jen: publish runbook + QA checklist and recruit internal app by Monday
- luis: confirm 3 ambassador customers and coordinate comms
Can we get thumbs up here? :thumbsup:
alex: :thumbsup:
samir: :thumbsup:
jen: :thumbsup:
luis: :thumbsup: i'll confirm names
deploy-bot: Deployment window reserved: 2024-05-14 02:00 UTC (placeholder) — awaiting final ok from owners.
maya: Thanks team — I'll synthesize these into the initiative doc and update the roadmap slice. if anyone objects to the 3-customer canary, speak now, otherwise i'll lock the gating this afternoon. :eyes:
alex: no objections.
jen: no objections.
